provider: Stadt Köln / Amt für Landschaftspflege und Grünflächen

request_contract.parameter_rules: Only the provider-published ms:baumkataster layer under fixed WFS 2.0.0 requests. GetCapabilities; GetFeature RESULTTYPE=hits COUNT=1; or one GeoJSON feature with COUNT=1, SORTBY=Baumnummer, optionally fixed STARTINDEX=0,750,2500,5000,10000 for a separate explicitly opted-in six-call CRS challenge. No caller-defined host, uncontrolled offsets, BBOX, arbitrary field filters, redirects, pagination loops, credentials or bulk download. Read and discard original responses in memory; never print individual tree IDs, names, street labels or original coordinates.

response_contract.format: Official WFS 2.0 GetCapabilities XML; FeatureCollection hits XML; one FeatureCollection Point GeoJSON subtype with 16 source attribute keys. Provider GetCapabilities default EPSG:25832.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Only municipality-managed street and municipal-object trees, not all Köln trees. GeoJSON source Points were empirically metre-like and had NO CRS declaration; even EPSG:4326-requested JSON and GML may expose metre coordinates. A sample of five sorted offsets projected under the EPSG:25832 hypothesis into the city KGG bounding envelope, which is not full georeferencing validation. Baumnummer sort is necessary because unsorted first feature differed on immediate repeated requests. These trees do not represent insured assets, storm damage observations or validated fall frequencies.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Only explicitly initiated bounded research checks, no provider polling, uncontrolled pagination, arbitrary BBOX or bulk extracts. No numeric API quota established.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Live municipality layers are mutable. Pin request URL, retrieval UTC, response SHA-256, source identity and geometry/CRS; offset ordering alone is not a stable snapshot.

rights_and_policy.notes: Original city WFS ServiceIdentification/AccessConstraints explicitly states Datenlizenz Deutschland Zero 2.0 and no fees. For this access contract only a tightly bounded anonymous manual metadata/hits/one-feature research operation is treated as technically and legally accessible. General redistribution, committed raw source rows, automatic scheduled collection, model training, insurer allocation, personal claims or asset-specific model admission are NOT approved. Independent source/scientific/admission review remains required. No unbounded automated polling is authorised.

expected_evidence: Original anonymous HTTP 200, no redirect; exact official host, path, fixed WFS query and documented layer.
Bounded Content-Type and original response SHA-256, byte count and retrieval UTC.
Response XML/JSON structure, layer identity, limited count and geometry/CRS semantics explicitly inspected.
External source bytes persisted=false, model admitted=false; protect source fields and IDs from raw logging.

notes: Original source WFS GetCapabilities independently observed, service uses DL-DE Zero 2.0. Original read-only GetFeature hits with COUNT=1 returned FeatureCollection numberReturned=0, numberMatched=1, which is not the total tree count. Original one-feature GeoJSON response 643 bytes had SHA-256 e958485ea97d6aa80e8d19575fc2fa8c472eeedb23abebce1e5c0f2c8f0b34ad before explicit sorting; that byte hash is not immutable source identity. Additional sorted five-offset original feature inspections plus repeated sort-key tests are documented. Exact source runner research_runners/cologne_public_wfs_feature_probe_v0.py and optional challenge runner research_runners/cologne_tree_crs_challenge_v0.py; external tree objects remain outside Git and production DB.
